verdict.rationale: Orama ships an answer engine and an agent-building runtime, so consuming external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The evidence, however, only documents Orama acting as an MCP server, exposing project data to assistants like ChatGPT and Cursor. Nothing shows Orama connecting to third-party MCP servers or using their tools. The server-side capability and the generic JavaScript agent runtime are a different role and a developer building block, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
